image_description: A close-up photograph of a yellow coral fungus (Ramaria or similar genus) growing on dark forest floor debris. The fungus features a complex, multi-branched structure with numerous upright, cylindrical branches that divide repeatedly into finer tips. The color is predominantly pale yellow to cream, with slightly darker yellow-orange hues at the branch tips. The texture appears smooth and matte. The background consists of blurred brown leaves and twigs, indicating a shallow depth of field.
